### Kings of Judah: Amaziah’s God of Plenty
Author: Kevin DeYoung
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/kevin-deyoung/kings-of-judah-amaziahs-god-of-plenty/
Passage: 2 Chronicles 25:9
Points:
- Amaziah surrendered his financial investment in mercenary troops after a prophet warned that God was not with them.
- The prophet assured the king that the Lord could provide far more than what was forfeited in obedience.
- God often brings about victory through improbable situations to show that the power belongs to Him.
- While this promise is not a guarantee of material wealth, believers should avoid faithless risk-aversion.
- When God's people do His work His way, they will never lack His necessary provision.
